newsitem.title: USA: Oryx Technology to buy Power Sensors.
newsitem.headline: Oryx Technology to buy Power Sensors.

text.p: Oryx Technology Corp said on Tuesday that its Power Products subsidiary has agreed to acquire the assets of Power Sensors Inc and to employ its key engineers and other personnel.

Power Sensors, a privately-held company based in Schaumberg, Ill., had 1995 revenues of $1 million and was purchased by Oryx Power Products for 6 percent of the outstanding stock of Oryx's wholly-owned subsidiary, Power Products, the company said.
A dollar value of the deal could not immediately be determined.
Manufacturing operations of Power Sensors will be integrated into Power Products' existing facilities in Reynosa, Mexico, Oryx said.
Oryx said it expects the product line from Power Sensors to contribute to profits in the second quarter of fiscal 1998, the quarter ended August 1997. The company's fiscal year ends in February.
This acquisition is expected to substantially offset the anticipated reduction in Oryx Power Products business in fiscal 1998 from its customer Pitney Bowes Inc.
